text:
marina-legal: FYI, Acme Cloud's PO 378412 is getting rejected by the marketplace invoicing flow. Procurement says entity on PO doesn't match our vendor record and they're holding payment. Need quick escalation. :worried:
ashley-acct: Can you paste the PO header? need the exact billing entity string so I can look up the vendor mapping.
marina-legal: "BillTo: Acme Cloud LLC" — but our vendor file expects "Redwood Inference, Inc." and marketplace maps to partner billing agent "Redwood Inc.". So it's a mismatch across three systems.
liam-sales: Customer bought via AWS Marketplace listing (reserved capacity). They submitted PO via their internal procurement template, not the marketplace checkout. They expect billing to flow through marketplace, but PO went to our finance team directly.
sara-partnerships: @liam-sales can you confirm whether this went through the private offer flow or just a standard listing? If private offer, we might need the marketplace PO number to reconcile.
liam-sales: It's a private offer. Marketplace PO number is MKT-ACME-2026-09 but the customer's procurement tool attached their internal PO 378412 as well.
jordan-ops: deploy-bot indicates the portal routing service returned 422 for PO 378412. See log snippet:
```:
INFO route-service: reconcile_request failed {po_id: "378412", marketplace_id: "MKT-ACME-2026-09", reason: "billing_entity_mismatch"}
```
deploy-bot: webhook delivered to billing-mapper v2 at 2026-03-21T11:02:31Z, response 422
marina-legal: Procurement insists on exact legal entity string; legal redlined the Partner Agreement to include their registered name on invoices. They won't accept anything else. :no_good:
ashley-acct: Short-term workaround: we can accept the customer's internal PO and issue a manual invoice referencing the marketplace PO. That must be approved by finance and could delay recognition. Do we have sign-off for manual invoicing for this account?
sara-partnerships: I'll open an escalation with Marketplace support now. @billing-ops do we have a mapping override we can apply to map "Acme Cloud LLC" -> our Redwood vendor id for this private offer?
billing-ops: we can add a temporary alias, but it needs legal + sales sign-off. I'll prep the admin change request form. ETA 4 hours if approved.
dmitri-eng: On the routing side we can add a tolerant match for billing entity tokens (strip punctuation, common abbreviations) — low effort patch but needs deployment.
jordan-ops: Patch helps future cases but still doesn't solve the legal redline that wants the exact string on invoice.
marina-legal: Correct. Legal won't accept fuzzy matches. We need either (1) marketplace mapping override, (2) manual invoice tied to marketplace PO, or (3) customer resubmits PO with the exact legal name. Which route do we prefer?
liam-sales: Customer is out-of-office today, can't do resubmit. Sales prefers (1) or (2) to avoid churn.
sara-partnerships: I'm escalating to Marketplace ERS and copying partner success. Raising ticket: https://marketplace.example.com/support/tickets/new -> ref MKT-ACME-ESC-623
sara-partnerships: @marina-legal @ashley-acct I'll attach the customer's contract redline and the PO mapping screenshots. Expect reply from marketplace in 2-3 business hours, will ping here.
marina-legal: I'll prepare a one-off waiver doc in case marketplace won't accept override. Need signatory from revenue operations.
ashley-acct: If we go manual invoice route, need GL code and revenue deferral guidance. @finance-lead can you advise?
finance-lead: Manual invoice is ok as a contingency; we'll need to put revenue on hold until funds clear and ensure we record the marketplace ref number. I'll sign the admin form once billing-ops sends it.
sara-partnerships: Marketplace replied (ticket MKT-ACME-ESC-623): "We can apply an alias to vendor mapping for private offers. Please provide evidence of customer authorization and the contract clause." They asked for PDF of redline.
marina-legal: Uploaded redline to the ticket and added the customer's PO and SOW. :thumbsup:  
sara-partnerships: Marketplace asked for partner account owner approval. @liam-sales can you confirm you authorize the mapping override?
liam-sales: Approved. Authorizing alias mapping for Acme Cloud LLC -> Redwood Inference vendor id. 
billing-ops: Admin change scheduled, will take effect after 1 hour. I'll post confirmation here.
billing-ops: Done — mapping alias applied at 2026-03-21T12:45:02Z. Marketplace should accept PO now.
jordan-ops: Re-ran reconciliation, webhook success 200, invoice queued.
ashley-acct: Invoice processed, created AR record INV-2026-ACME-009. I'll follow up on payment ETA with Accounts Payable.
marina-legal: Thanks everyone. Closing on this thread once payment confirmed. :sparkles: 
liam-sales: Great teamwork. Please DM me any follow-ups with the customer.
deploy-bot: ticket MKT-ACME-ESC-623 closed by marketplace-support at 2026-03-21T13:05:12Z
